content: कुम्भः [कुं भूमिं कुत्सितं वा उम्भति पूरयति उम्भ्-अच् शकं˚ <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 A pitcher, water-pot, jar; इयं सुस्तनी मस्तकन्यस्तकुम्भा <ls>Jag.</ls>; वर्जयेत्तादृशं मित्रं विषकुम्भं पयोमुखम् <ls>H. 1. 74</ls>; <ls>R. 2. 36</ls>; so कुच˚, स्तन˚. .²2 The frontal globe on the forehead of an elephant; इभकुम्भ <ls>Māl. 5. 32</ls>; मत्तेभकुम्भदलने भुवि सन्ति शूराः <ls>Bh. 1. 59</ls>. .²3 Aquarius, the eleventh sign of the zodiac. .²4 A measure of grain equal to 20 droṇas; धान्यं दशभ्यः कुम्भेभ्यो हरतोऽभ्यधिकं वधः <ls>Ms. 8. 320</ls>. .²5 (In Yoga <ab>phil.</ab>) Closing the nostrils and mouth so as to suspend breathing. .²6 The paramour of a harlot. .²7 An urn in which the bones of dead bodies are collected. .²8 A kind of heart-disease. .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of a plant (and also of its fruit); क्वचिद् बिल्वैः क्वचित्कुम्भैः क्वचिच्चामलकमुष्टिभिः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 18. 14</ls>. .{@-भा@} A harlot, a whore. .{@-भम्@} A fragrant resin (गुग्गुल).
